The '''Great Raptor''' was term used by the [[Nediji]] race in one of their old sayings. It states that everyone is never more than seven wings away from the Great Raptor, meaning everyone can find a connection or link to somebody else by going through their known contacts.<ref name="MedStar II: Jedi Healer">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>
